messages:
marc: Short follow-up from today's all-hands re: headcount realignment. Recording + slides: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1832109876 :spiral_calendar:
sophia: TL;DR: we're shifting hiring capacity toward Platform Reliability and Dedicated customer work given enterprise demand. This is a reallocation of open budget, not a hiring freeze forever.
alexa: Immediate action: an operational hiring hold goes into effect now while we run a 72-hour triage to reclassify reqs into priority buckets (critical / can-delay / internal-transfer). Expect a paused list after triage.
devon: Numbers please 150 people now. What's the headcount delta?
sophia: Rough math: company ~150. We are tightening net hiring by ~8% for Q2 (about ~12 FTE equivalents deferred). Of those, ~7 slots will be funneled toward Platform Reliability & Dedicated work.
cheng: Is anyone being laid off? Managers need answers for their teams.
sophia: No broad layoffs as part of this change. The primary lever is pausing external reqs and reallocating priorities. If any role faces other actions we'll coordinate privately via People Ops.
paul: Recruiting process: all open reqs marked `on-hold` by default. Managers can submit an exception request in #recruiting-approvals with impact metrics + timeline. We will review within 72 hours. Tag exceptions as `critical-hire` or `inference-impact` for routing.
hr-bot: Manager talk track + petition form: https://redwood.internal/hr/headcount-q2. Confidential support: People Ops DM.
marc: Suggested 1:1 script: "We are reallocating hiring to meet immediate enterprise reliability needs. We're pausing some external hiring briefly while we review. If your role is impacted, we'll discuss next steps and internal options privately"
devon: What about internal mobility? Engineers who want to move into Platform Reliability?
paul: Internal candidates encouraged 1 internal apps will be `fast-track` and prioritized. Hiring managers: please respond to internal apps within 5 business days.
cheng: Contractors & renewals?
sophia: Contractors will be evaluated case-by-case. Expect some non-critical renewals deferred; business-critical contractors can be extended with approval from Finance + Eng Leads.
alexa: Research hiring nuance: roles tied directly to inference delivery (runtime, quantization, Dedicated integration) are eligible to proceed; broad exploratory hires will be deprioritized. Route inference-related reqs with `inference-impact`.
devon: Will interview loops or leveling change?
sophia: No leveling changes. We will temporarily add an infra/product reviewer for Dedicated-priority roles and apply stricter justification for external hires.
paul: I'll post a spreadsheet of current open reqs + owners in #all-hands-updates within 72 hours. Managers: prepare your exception forms now.
hr-bot: Severance & benefits FAQ (if needed): https://redwood.internal/hr/severance-q2. People Ops available for private chats.
marc: Thanks all. We know these conversations are stressful; our aim is quick, transparent decisions. Closing thread 1 will update when paused-list + org sketch are live.
